→ https://t.co/t3o1gp5VXw

4. AirI: Open-source AI companion built for real-time interaction and voice.

→ https://t.co/vuly3gvAyX

5. Headroom: Explores context compression while keeping the information that matters.

→ https://t.co/tgNHKav4uE
